other_conditions: The applicant must be a registered woman worker under the Telangana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
If applying as a wife or daughter, the related construction worker must be registered under the same board
The worker must have been registered for at least 12 months before the date of delivery
Assistance can be received only twice (up to two deliveries or two daughters)
If both parents are registered workers, only one parent is eligible for the scheme amount
Applications must be submitted within one year from the date of delivery
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹30,000 per delivery (₹10,000 at the 7th month of pregnancy and ₹20,000 after delivery)
